story.title: Pamela Rose Hiles – June 29, 1932 – Nov. 8, 2026
story.summary: Pamela R. Hiles, 94, of Fort Worth, passed away Sunday, Nov. 8, 2026, at the Community Health Care Center of Texas in Fort Worth, following a brief illness.
